pages.text: The $(item)Draconic Reactor$() turns $(l:getting_started/awakened_draconium)Awakened Draconium$(/l) into huge amounts of energy. It is also the most dangerous thing in the mod: if its containment field fails it explodes, and a full-size reactor leaves a crater hundreds of blocks wide.

$(c)Untested in this port.$() Upstream also reports odd behaviour, such as the core jumping straight to 2,500 °C on start-up. Build and test it in a copy of the world before you build one on the server.

pages.title: Outline
pages.text: $(li)$(l:endgame/reactor_building)Build it$(/l): a core, four Reactor Stabilizers around it and at least one Reactor Energy Injector.$(li)$(l:endgame/reactor_operation)Fuel and run it$(/l): load Awakened Draconium, charge it from a big energy store, activate it, then balance what goes in against what comes out with Flow Gates.$(li)$(l:endgame/reactor_safety)Keep it safe$(/l): know what makes it fail and how to shut it down.
The parts need $(l:endgame/chaos_guardian)Chaos Shards$(/l), and you need a large buffer such as an $(l:energy_core/overview)Energy Core$(/l).
The core goes in the middle. It grows as it heats up, so keep the space around it empty.
